description: A cheap seat disposes every returned paper as direct, adjacent, off-lane or garbage, with discovery value and seed suitability; batch verdict bands (more than two thirds, one third to two thirds, under one third) drive CONTINUE, FOCUS or ABANDON. Novelty signals (seen before, times seen, trend) read saturation.
researcher_question: How much of what came back is what we wanted, and is the well running dry?
